mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_checkpoint_artifacts (task_uuid, task_id, artifact_type, payload_json, item_count, schema_version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{taskUuid}, #{taskId}, #{artifactType}, #{payloadJson}, #{itemCount}, #{schemaVersion}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE task_id = VALUES(task_id), payload_json = VALUES(payload_json), item_count = VALUES(item_count), schema_version = VALUES(schema_version), updated_at = NOW()
